Before you buy

Good to know

  • Some games need preparation, including answers collected from the bride or couple beforehand.
  • He Said, She Said needs the host to collect and choose real quotes before the party.
  • The Shoe Game needs both partners present.
  • Print guest sheets per player or team, and host sheets once.
  • Each Bingo game has five card designs. You can reuse them for larger groups, and more than one winner is possible.
  • Printed colors vary between screens, printers, inks and paper.
  • Personal-use license. Resale and redistribution are not permitted. Digital download only; nothing is shipped.

Quick answers

Do I need to play all 15 games?

No. Choose the activities that suit your group and time. The Host Guide suggests 1-, 2- and 3-hour plans.

Which file should I print?

Open the folder for your paper size (US Letter or A4), then choose Color or Low-Ink. Test-print one page first.

Where can I get printing help?

See the printing tips and FAQ pages on our store.
